title: Counting Objects to 10
seo_title: Grade R Counting to 10 Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_code: Grade R: Count objects; count forwards and backwards
standard_text: Estimate and count to at least 10 everyday objects reliably; count forwards and backwards in ones from 1 to 10.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade R maths worksheets: counting objects to 10, counting forwards and backwards, and counting stories. 100 questions with pictures and memos.
key_sub: The last number tells you how many.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Touch each object once as you say the number.
  • The last number you say tells you how many.
  • Count forwards: 1, 2, 3 … 10.
  • Count backwards: 10, 9, 8 … 1.

Examples

Example

Count the apples: one, two, three, four

the last number is 4

Answer: 4

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Counting twiceTouch each object once.
Missing oneMove each object as you count it.
The orderSay the numbers in order.

faq.a: The Reception Year, the year before Grade 1 and the first year of the Foundation Phase. Learners are about 5 to 6 years old.

faq.q: How far do Grade R learners count objects?
faq.a: To 5 at first, then to 7, and to 10 by the end of the year.
It gets learners ready for taking away.
Yes. Count blocks, beads, bottle tops and fingers first, then pictures.
